commands.name: extract
commands.functionality: Send a task or question to one or more existing agents and return their answers.
commands.example: Ask an existing suitable agent to perform a task.

commands.name: create_agent
commands.functionality: Create a new specialized LLM agent. Do not choose a physical model. The backend ModelRegistry automatically assigns an available base model according to server policy.
commands.example: Create a new specialist for a domain that is not covered by existing agents.

commands.name: edit_agent
commands.functionality: Edit role metadata of an existing agent. Physical model assignment is managed by the backend, not by Handler.
commands.example: Update the role, description, or tags of an existing agent.

commands.name: delete_agent
commands.functionality: Remove an existing agent from the registry.

commands.name: cancel
commands.functionality: Cancel the requested operation without changing agents or data.

commands.name: list_agents
commands.functionality: Show all available agents and their metadata.
commands.example: Show the agents currently available in the system.

commands.name: add
commands.functionality: Add new data or knowledge to an existing agent memory.
commands.example: Save supplied knowledge to a selected existing agent.

commands.name: delete
commands.functionality: Delete a data or memory entry from an existing agent.
commands.example: Remove an obsolete memory entry from an agent.

commands.name: edit
commands.functionality: Modify an existing data or memory entry inside an agent.
commands.example: Update an existing memory entry in an agent.

commands.name: load
commands.functionality: Attach a file to a specifically named existing agent. Use only when the user explicitly selects the destination agent. For automatic file/image/drawing/PDF processing and routing, use route_document instead.
commands.example: Load a referenced file into a specifically selected existing agent.

commands.name: route_document
commands.functionality: Process and intelligently route any referenced file. Text files use the text pipeline. Images, drawings, scans, and PDF files are automatically sent through the visual/drawing pipeline (OpenCV/OCR/diagram extraction) before semantic routing. If no existing agent is suitable, the document-routing subsystem may propose and create a new specialized agent; physical model selection is automatic in the backend.
commands.example: Process and route a referenced document, image, drawing, scan, or PDF to the most suitable destination.

commands.name: resolve_logger_conflicts
commands.functionality: Analyze registry metrics and resolve logger conflicts through the central self-organization process.

commands.name: consolidate
commands.functionality: Merge two or more existing agents into one new agent when their responsibilities substantially overlap.
commands.example: Merge overlapping agents into one consolidated specialist.

commands.name: split
commands.functionality: Split one overly broad existing agent into multiple more focused agents.
commands.example: Split an overly broad agent into focused specialists.

commands.name: no_action
commands.functionality: Do nothing when no system change or execution is required.

commands.name: save_system_state
commands.functionality: Save current system state, agent registry, conflicts, and runtime metrics to server log files.
